passages.context: Whiston I.10.3 abridges Genesis 15: it retains the promise that Abram's posterity will be as numerous as the stars and immediately reports the commanded sacrifice, but omits the command to look outside or upward and the chapter's setting, sunset, darkness, and concluding temporal formula.

work.author: Flavius Josephus
work.description: Josephus's twenty-book history of the Jewish people, completed c. 93/94 CE. Book 12 retells the Letter of Aristeas's account of the Greek translation of the Law under Ptolemy II. Loci use book with Whiston chapter or chapter.section numbering; consumers state which numbering they follow.
work.title: Antiquitates Judaicae
